scenarios: Productive binational integration and domestic capability creation
Digital infrastructure enclave and implicit electricity subsidies
Severe hydrology or transmission shock limiting reliability
contrary_evidence: The treaty grants both Brazil and Paraguay sovereign 50% electricity entitlements and the US project announcement does not alone establish violation.
Crusoe–Araico's 106 MW and 280 MW are prospective IT capacity milestones, not observed grid energy use.
Paraguay's domestic electricity use has risen, changing the opportunity cost of energy historically ceded to Brazil.
US commercial influence is documented in October 2026; unlawful or military interference has not been substantiated.
